name: Featured sale banner
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Featured sale banner.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Recommended sizes — Desktop: 2400×800, Laptop: 1800×700, Tablet: 1400×700, Mobile: 900×1100. Use WebP when possible and keep each file under ~300–500KB.

settings.label: Image — desktop
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Link URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Link label (ARIA)
settings.info: If Link URL is set, this label is used for accessibility (example: “Shop Spring Sale”).
settings.how: Enter the link label (aria). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Height mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for height mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.content: Linking: Point to a Deals page / sale collection / financing offer / campaign landing page. Add UTM parameters for tracking if running ads.
Accessibility: If the banner is clickable, set a clear ARIA link label (e.g., “Shop Spring Sale”).
